climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A sweet white DOCG from the hills near Nimis in Friuli-Venezia Giulia, made from a local Verduzzo variety, Verduzzo Friulano. It has been DOCG since 2001, and before that was a subzone of Colli Orientali del Friuli.
